easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Tarpan from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Tarpan by paying {G}.
Repeat.
